updates.title: Updates
updates.install_hint: The update downloads in the app, then Android asks you to confirm the install (the first time also to allow installs from this app).
updates.no_apk: This release has no APK - download the update from the release page.
updates.installer_opened: Installer opened - confirm the install. The app restarts as the new version.
updates.install_error: Could not download the update. Check your connection and try again.
updates.install_invalid: The downloaded file is not a newer version of the app - download the update from the release page.
updates.install_android: Updates are installed in the Android app.
updates.web: The web version updates itself. You can check the latest release manually.
updates.ios: On iOS the app does not update itself - install the new version the same way you installed the app (e.g. App Store or TestFlight). You can check the latest release manually.
updates.up_to_date: You are on the latest version.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.empty: Nothing planned for the next 7 days.
